I LIVE!!! AFTER MONTHS OF WAITING AND DRAGGING MYSELF TO MY COMPUTER, I HAVE RETURNED TO BRING YOU ALL THE 8TH EPISODE OF SYMBIOTIC COMPANION! Sorry, everyone, for the long wait. It's been MONTHS since I gave you a proper story, mainly because I've had less free time to make Koi stories. HOWEVER, I have returned again, and I am giving you a product I feel confident enough to share with all of you. This is Symbiotic Companion Episode 8: "Thank you..."

Previously, on Symbiotic Companion, Sophie has protected the streets and saved people from Nadia's Symbiote Spawns. However, one accidental capture almost corrupted her. The next day, the military escorted Genny back to base to de-bond her from Symbie. But along the way, Nadia attacks their convoy and reveals she has captured and corrupted Jane. Now, Genny is trapped in a military compound and is confronted by an alien ambassador, Klyntar. Klyntar reveals he is from the race that destroyed the symbiote home world, and that Symbie was the one who got the planet destroyed. How did that happen? Who is the mysterious alien commander? And what will be the fate of Symbie and Genny? Find out here on the 8th Episode of Symbiotic Companion!
